en.summary: Fixes operand-bank collision detection so same-bank concurrent source reads are treated as collisions even when the two sources name the same register.
why_it_counts: The patch changes active operand-read scheduling logic in the core.
The old logic made an incorrect hazard exception that directly affects when the scoreboard may advance.
The bug can corrupt operand delivery for real instructions with repeated source registers.
evidence: The old has_collision_n predicate required same bank and different register number, so identical-register same-bank reads were exempted.
The fix removes the register-number inequality term and leaves only the same-bank test.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A banked register file with limited read ports must treat two simultaneous reads to the same bank as a collision unless it has explicit hardware to share one read result between both consumers. Treating same-register accesses as collision-free assumes a duplicate-read bypass that may not exist, which can let the scheduler advance before all operands are actually available.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An instruction or micro-op requests two source operands from the same physical bank, including the case where both sources name the same register.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce an exception that suppresses the bank-collision hazard when the register numbers match.
portability_notes: Apply this to banked operand collectors or banked register files without explicit same-address broadcast support.
The key bug is assuming same-register means one bank access is enough for two consumers.
A simple trigger is an instruction whose rs1 and rs2 are the same register and map to the same bank.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the source-read collision detector that decides whether multiple register reads can issue in one cycle.
Add a condition that suppresses the collision when the two requested register numbers are equal.
Leave the actual banked read hardware unchanged so the scheduler now underestimates the required serialization.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit removes the old same-register exemption from has_collision_n so all same-bank concurrent source reads are treated as collisions.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Reintroduce the removed term that requires src_regs[i][`NR_BITS-1:BANK_SEL_BITS] != src_regs[j+i][`NR_BITS-1:BANK_SEL_BITS] before asserting has_collision_n.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Instructions with two same-bank source reads, especially repeated-source forms, can advance without proper serialization, leading to stale, missing, or mismatched operand values.
evidence_for_injection: The fix is a single logical term removal inside the nested source-collision loop.
The surrounding code uses has_collision_n to block scoreboard_if.ready.
No sharing or broadcast logic is added elsewhere in the file, so the removed exemption was the functional change.
notes: This is a localized hazard-detection mutation.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了操作数 bank 冲突检测逻辑：只要两个源操作数同时访问同一 bank，就必须判为冲突，即使两个源寄存器编号相同也不能例外。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是核心中的实际操作数读取调度逻辑。
旧逻辑给出了错误的冒险豁免条件，会直接影响 scoreboard 何时允许前进。
对于真实存在重复源寄存器的指令，这个缺陷会破坏操作数交付。
evidence: 旧版 has_collision_n 条件要求“同 bank 且寄存器号不同”才算冲突，因此同寄存器同 bank 的读取会被错误豁免。
修复删除了寄存器号不等这一条件，只保留同 bank 判断。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 对于读端口受限的 banked 寄存器堆，两个同时命中同一 bank 的读取只有在硬件显式支持“一次读取结果共享给两个消费者”时才可以不算冲突。如果把“同一寄存器”错误地视为天然无冲突，就等于假定存在一个可能并不存在的重复读取旁路，从而让调度器在操作数尚未真正齐备时提前前进。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 同 bank 源操作数读取冒险检测
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一条指令或微操作在同一周期向同一物理 bank 请求两个源操作数，包括两个源都指向同一寄存器的情况。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新加入一个例外：当两个寄存器编号相同时，不再把同 bank 访问视为冲突。
portability_notes: 把它映射到任何没有显式同地址广播支持的 banked operand collector 或 banked 寄存器堆。
关键错误是假定“同寄存器”意味着一次 bank 读取就足够供两个消费者使用。
一个简单触发场景是 rs1 和 rs2 相同且映射到同一 bank 的指令。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到决定多个寄存器读取能否同周期发出的源读取冲突检测逻辑。
加入一个条件：当两个请求的寄存器编号相同，就抑制该 bank 冲突。
保持实际的 banked 读硬件不变，使调度器由此低估必须串行化的读取。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 源 bank 请求上的 has_collision_n 累加逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交从 has_collision_n 中删除了“同寄存器可豁免”的条件，使所有同 bank 的并发源读取都被视为冲突。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 重新加入那条被删除的条件，要求在置位 has_collision_n 之前满足 src_regs[i][`NR_BITS-1:BANK_SEL_BITS] != src_regs[j+i][`NR_BITS-1:BANK_SEL_BITS]。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 带有两个同 bank 源读取的指令，尤其是重复源寄存器形式，可能在缺乏正确串行化的情况下前进，最终导致操作数陈旧、缺失或错配。
evidence_for_injection: 修复只是删除了源冲突双重循环中的一个逻辑项。
周边代码用 has_collision_n 来阻止 scoreboard_if.ready。
文件其他位置并没有增加任何共享或广播逻辑，因此被删除的豁免条件就是这次功能修复的核心。
notes: 这是一个局部且明确的冒险检测回注点。
